cards.text: It's the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah the prophet. God sends him to a family called the Rechabites, to bring them into one of the rooms of the house of the LORD. And baker, this is one of those assignments you read once, read twice, then read a THIRD time just to make sure.

cards.question: God tells Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into a room in the house of the LORD and offer them a drink of ___.

cards.text: So Jeremiah gathers the entire house of the Rechabites, starting with Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah. Different Jeremiah, friend, since our prophet's father is Hilkiah (Jeremiah 1:1), and that's like two Dorins in one kitchen, and trust me, ONE was plenty.

He brings them to the room of the sons of Hanan, a man of God, near the officials' room, which sits above the doorkeeper's room. That's how I give directions to the sprinkles: by the oven, above the drawer, no, the OTHER drawer.

Jeremiah sets pitchers full of wine and some cups in front of the Rechabite men and tells them, "Drink some wine." Not a sip, friend, PITCHERS, like me putting out one cookie tray and then four MORE "just in case."

cards.question: The pitchers of wine are on the table, and the prophet Jeremiah tells the Rechabites to drink. True or false: the Rechabites drink some.
The Rechabites tell Jeremiah they don't drink wine because they were commanded not to. Who gave them that command?

cards.text: And Jonadab didn't stop at wine: "Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard." Forget house rules, baker, these folks don't even GET a house!

cards.question: No houses for the Rechabites. Their forefather Jonadab told them to live in ___ all their lives.
Jonadab gave the Rechabites a reason for living in tents and never planting or building. What was it?

answers.text: So they could live a long time in the land
So they could always be ready for war
So they could stay far away from kings

cards.question: True or false: the Rechabites say only the men of the family have kept Jonadab's command not to drink wine.

cards.text: No houses, no vineyards, no fields, no crops, and they've done exactly as Jonadab commanded. Meanwhile, I once promised myself I'd stop sneaking chocolate chips, and that lasted ONE batch.
But hold on, these are tent people, and right now they're staying in Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, has marched into the land.

cards.question: When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, why did the tent-dwelling Rechabites go into Jerusalem?

answers.text: To escape the armies coming in
To join the army of Judah
To buy land and finally settle

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah again, sending him to the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem: "Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?" Baker, I know that tone, it's the one I use on MYSELF after burning the same batch twice.

cards.question: Now God points Judah to the Rechabites. What does He say about the words their forefather Jonadab gave them?

answers.text: They were too hard to keep

cards.text: Jonadab's sons haven't drunk wine to this very day, because they obeyed their forefather. ONE command, still standing, and I can't get past my 6 a.m. alarm without three rounds with the snooze button.

cards.question: True or false: God tells the people of Judah that He has spoken to them only once.

cards.text: Again and again, God sent all His servants the prophets to them. That's my oven timer going off TEN times while I stand there asking, "Is something beeping?"

cards.question: What did God's prophets keep telling the people of Judah to do?
God's prophets also warned Judah not to go after other ___ to serve them.

cards.text: Judah hasn't listened, and God sets the two side by side: Jonadab's sons kept their forefather's command, but these people have not listened to Him. That's the boss saying "Why can't you be more like Steve?" except Steve is a WHOLE FAMILY.

cards.question: So God says He will bring on Judah and all the residents of Jerusalem all the ___ He has pronounced against them.
True or false: God says this disaster comes on Judah because He spoke to them and they did not obey, and He called to them and they did not answer.

cards.text: Then Jeremiah turns to the Rechabites with a word from the LORD of Hosts: they obeyed Jonadab, kept all his commandments, and did all he charged them to do. Now the spotlight swings over to Steve, and Steve is about to have a GOOD day.

cards.question: Because the Rechabites obeyed their forefather, what does the LORD of Hosts promise the family of Jonadab son of Rechab?

answers.text: A man to stand before God always
Fields and vineyards of their own
